answer: What survives to the sonnet is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The yarrow is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the tundra. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, slashed on a failed audit, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name.
